sources.snippet: It leverages TF-IDF vectorization and advanced text preprocessing techniques to handle noisy, real-world text data. The model supports multi-label classification, meaning a single comment can belong to multiple toxicity categories simultaneously.

sources.title: GitHub - toxiclassify/Main: Multilabel toxic comment classification ...
sources.snippet: It studies the Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge as a six-label text classification problem. A comment may be tagged as toxic, severe_toxic, obscene, threat, insult, or identity_hate. The work began with label imbalance, co-occurrence, comment length, and data-quality checks.
